dataset: citywide sample of block faces (batch run)

method.selection: per local area, the grid windows with most City trees; within a window, trees on distinct (hblock, side) faces of streetuse=Residential streets, not in a park polygon, not median (seeded shuffle 20260928)
method.site_type: boulevard ASSUMED for every face (DESIGN_ASSUMPTION); the tool asks the user

knobs.curb: median catch-basin offset on the face (City, 'location approximate'), DESIGN_ASSUMPTION

method.largest_class_fits: largest Table 9-2 Shared/Row class met by more than half of the trees with a KNOWN share (Large 20, Medium 15, Small 5 m³); DERIVED_CALCULATION
method.share: band share per tree = front boulevard width × 0.9 m × measured tributary length, cut by Table 2-2 clearance strips (R26/R28); REVIEW = tree inside a clearance strip or outside the band
method.windows: 0.004° grid, radius 500 m; Open Data context + underground layers and VanMap depth layers, contours skipped

colour_classes.unknown: no known share, or an implausible geometry hint (flag)

plausibility.note: faces beyond these bounds keep their numbers but are coloured unknown and carry a flag
